title: Living Legacy: Marathon
summary: Survive increasingly difficult rounds against I.R.A. and its clockwork reinforcements.
overview: Survive increasingly difficult rounds against I.R.A. and its clockwork reinforcements.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Face I.R.A. away from the raid; stand behind it to avoid Flamethrower.
Collect bashers, whirlygigs and repair clockworks as they enter.
Read the immunity label beneath each clockwork's name before choosing control; one enemy can have several immunities.
Use the respite between completed rounds to recover and prepare for stronger opponents.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
Marathon uses clockwork add waves; Sprint is documented separately.
